Player 5x5 moves 6px; blocked by HUD band y<8, x<14, edges, wall px in dest box unless it holds the plate centre; first input at w=64 is a no-op.
Plate covered by player/ghost -> key+bar left of the rope column shift +6; wall re-extracted with crop under layer-1 boxes; names type_{index:03d}.

New mechanic (step 43): ghost at trail[k-1] is hidden when it lands on the player's pre-move cell; counter -1 on odd calls (hidden parity, continuity-gated, stateless fallback assumes even step).
Unconfirmed: whether a hidden ghost reappears on a blocked move, ghost blocking, x<14 bound, respawn always (14,8).
